name: md2ui
description: md2ui shows ChatGPT or Codex replies as UI in a native window and returns the user's clicks and messages, with authoring tools to check and preview them.

interface.shortDescription: Show answers in a native md2ui window.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT or Codex writes ordinary Markdown, md2ui shows it as UI in a native window on your computer, and clicks and typed replies come back through MCP. Authoring tools check, outline and preview an answer before it is shown.
defaultPrompt: Open md2ui and show me what is new.
Show this answer in the md2ui window.
